stem.text: Proton pumps ($\text{H}^{+}$ pumps) and co-transporters are used by plants when loading sucrose into a phloem sieve tube element at a source.

A.text: pumps protons into a companion cell raising its pH; the high concentration of protons in the companion cell allows the transporter to be used for moving sucrose out of the cell

B.text: pumps protons into a mesophyll cell raising its pH; the high concentration of protons in a mesophyll cell drives the transport of sucrose into the cell

C.text: pumps protons out of a companion cell into its cell wall; the high concentration of protons outside a companion cell drives the transport of sucrose into the cell

D.text: pumps protons out of a mesophyll cell into its cell wall; the low concentration of protons in a mesophyll cell allows the transporter to be used for moving sucrose out of the cell
